notes.title: Fix Update 2025/08/25
notes.content: [p]◆Bug Fixes  [/p][p]・Corrected the school signboard display.  [/p][p]・Removed the strange door in the schoolyard (which appeared during the noise removal event).  [/p][p]・Fixed an issue where switching characters upon the third character's (Yuki)加入 caused a malfunction resulting in remote control mode.  [/p][p]・Fixed an issue where the game became unplayable due to loud train noises and announcements when no playable characters were available.[/p][p]• Changed so that you can no longer remove the controllable character or all characters from the party composition[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where you could no longer pick up your bag after sitting on a train while holding it[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where you couldn't put down desks or items (added explanations such as pressing the R stick to the menu screen's notes)[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where you couldn't escape after walking onto the tracks and getting stuck in the train's driver's seat[/p][p]• Added operation instructions to the menu screen's notes[/p][p]• Fixed the method for clearing the noise removal event[/p][p]◆Map-related[/p][p]• Placed convenience store staff[/p][p]• Installed a supermarket in the Matsunomiya area (no functionality)[/p][p]• Changed LOD (adjusts model detail based on camera distance) to be more detailed even at longer distances[/p][p]◆Character operation[/p][p]• Slightly adjusted character collision detection and height detection[/p]
